title: AP® Psychology
subject: Psychology
alignment: AP® Psychology exam (unit order follows the usual course sequence; outline written in our own words)

units.title: How psychologists study behavior
objectives: Choose between experiments, correlational studies, surveys and case studies for a research question
Identify independent and dependent variables, controls and possible confounds in a study
Interpret means, standard deviations, correlation coefficients and statistical significance
Explain the ethical rules that protect people and animals in research

units.title: The brain, the nervous system and the senses
objectives: Describe how neurons fire and how neurotransmitters and drugs change communication between them
Match major brain regions and the endocrine system to the behaviors they support
Explain how heredity and environment interact to shape behavior
Describe the stages of sleep, common sleep disorders, and how the senses turn energy into neural signals

units.title: Perception, memory and thinking
objectives: Explain how attention, expectations and context shape what we perceive
Trace information through encoding, storage and retrieval, and explain why we forget
Compare problem-solving strategies and the biases that lead judgments astray
Evaluate how intelligence is defined and measured, including test reliability and validity

units.title: Development and learning
objectives: Describe physical, cognitive and social development from infancy through old age
Compare major theories of cognitive and moral development
Explain classical and operant conditioning and predict the effects of reinforcement schedules
Describe how people learn by observing others

units.title: Social behavior, motivation and personality
objectives: Explain how people explain others' behavior and the errors they make in doing so
Describe how groups, roles and authority influence conformity, obedience and helping
Compare theories of motivation and emotion
Compare psychodynamic, humanistic, trait and social-cognitive views of personality

units.title: Mental and physical health
objectives: Explain how stress affects health and which coping strategies help
Describe the main categories of psychological disorders and how they are diagnosed
Compare psychological and biomedical treatments and the evidence for each
